name: codeg
description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.

features: Fifteen agents come built in, and any other ACP agent can join from the public registry or its distribution JSON. Codeg speaks the Agent Client Protocol to every one of them, so they all get the same rich conversation —…

Codeg reads the history every agent CLI keeps on disk: import it in one click, search all of it, and resume any session where it stopped. @-mention an old session and the agent you're talking to can read it — even one a…

Type @, pick an agent, send. Each mentioned agent runs as its own session, side by side, streaming back into your thread — Claude Code drafting while Codex reviews — and sub-agents show up as cards that fill in while…

Write a job down and walk away. Each to-do gets its own git worktree and branch, starts now or on a schedule, and waits in Review; accept the diff and the agent lands it, and Codeg checks git before calling it done.
